ostrzezenia.tekst: According to the FDA, nematode larvae have survived 28 days in an 80° salinometer brine (21% salt by weight).
The EU requires food businesses that sell marinated, salted and other treated fish products to freeze the raw fish or the finished product if the treatment is not enough to kill live parasites.
The FDA considers uneviscerated (ungutted) fish that are salt-cured, dried or smoked a potentially life-threatening health hazard.
According to the FDA, brining and pickling can reduce the parasite hazard in fish, but they do not eliminate it.

akapity: According to the FDA, gut any fish before salting, drying, pickling or fermenting it.
The FDA will consider seizing uneviscerated salt-cured, dried or smoked fish more than 5 inches long that are sold between states; this is a legal threshold, not a safety limit.
According to the FDA, freezing and storing fish at −20 °C (−4 °F) or below for 7 days in total kills parasites.
JarAtlas has found no tested home recipe for barrel-salted herring from a checked source.
